note: Reference copy of the ranked list shown on projects.html. Rank 1 is the most substantial.
ranking: Scope and engineering depth first (accounts, databases, access rules, offline support, size of the codebase), then polish and real-world use.

tiers.title: Flagship platforms
tiers.blurb: Full systems with accounts, databases and access rules, or large codebases with real users in mind.

tiers.title: Complete products
tiers.blurb: Finished apps and sites with their own features, data and offline support.

tiers.title: Guides, sites and tools
tiers.blurb: Focused sites, guides and utilities, each doing one job well.

tiers.title: Class exercises
tiers.blurb: Small starter projects from teaching sessions. Code only, no live site.

projects.title: School Fee Payment Portal
projects.summary: Fee and school-information portal for Knowledge Base International Schools. Parents see itemised fees and payments, staff see who has paid, and the owner sees the whole school's finances and runs data imports. Real accounts on Firebase.

projects.title: Techbase STEM Academy
projects.summary: The Techbase Consultant Services website plus a free academy of 472 lessons across eight courses, built from source files by a Python pipeline.

projects.title: Termbook
projects.summary: Free daily AM/PM attendance registers, per-subject score sheets and term report cards for Nigerian secondary schools. Admins, teachers and parents each see only what their role allows. Installs on a phone and works offline.

projects.title: RAISSAT Digital Food Systems Platform
projects.summary: Web platform for the RAISSAT digital food systems community project at FUTA, Akure: participant registration, pre and post assessments, certificates, a searchable toolkit directory and an administrator dashboard.

projects.title: Naija Monopoly
projects.summary: A Nigeria-themed Monopoly with the full official rules. Play it in the browser, or install the Windows desktop version built with Electron.

projects.title: Millionaire Mindset
projects.summary: A free quiz game in the browser: climb a 15-step prize ladder, use three lifelines, and choose between risking it and walking away.

projects.title: ISCGS Register
projects.summary: Register of students, staff and records for Ilado-Sagbo Community Grammar School: student roll, staff directory, attendance and assessment coverage, school profile and inventory. Only staff approved by an administrator can sign in.

projects.title: RCCG Training Portal
projects.summary: Mobile-first study portal that replaces three printed RCCG manuals (Believers', Baptismal and Workers-in-Training) with guided lessons, scripture that opens in place, class tests, notes, bookmarks and optional synced progress.

projects.title: Class Scoresheet
projects.summary: Scoresheet for teachers: create classes, load student lists, enter CA, open-day and exam marks, apply bonus marks, and get grades, positions and term-by-term report cards. Prints reports to PDF and exports to Excel in the paper-sheet layout. Each teacher sees only their own classes; works offline.

projects.title: QuizMaster
projects.summary: A quiz game with 400 questions, difficulty levels, a countdown timer and an online leaderboard. Players can also write their own questions.

projects.title: Global Warming Explorer
projects.summary: Interactive climate-science course with a footprint calculator, charts, quizzes, certificates and a classroom check-in dashboard. Written from a background in atmospheric physics.

projects.title: Kingdom Quiz (Bible Trivia)
projects.summary: Host-led Bible trivia for church game nights. One person hosts on the big screen, up to four players take turns, and the audience joins from their phones with a four-letter code.

projects.title: Attendance Register
projects.summary: Daily AM/PM attendance register for teachers, with weekly and term reports, student records, a holiday calendar and CSV export. Shared through Firebase and usable offline.

projects.title: Deploybase
projects.summary: A directory of configured Claude Projects, each with its working page and the exact instructions behind it.

projects.title: Bible Family Feud
projects.summary: Family Feud-style Bible quiz for church events. Two teams guess the most popular answers while a host flips tiles and calls strikes from one screen. No install, no account, no server.

projects.title: Daily Greetings
projects.summary: Writes warm, prayerful WhatsApp greetings that fit the day and time, different for every contact. Review one, tap once, and WhatsApp opens ready to send. Keeps track of who you have greeted.

projects.title: PromptOS
projects.summary: Over 200 working AI prompts for image generation, careers, social media, presentations and business. Fill in the blanks, copy, and go. Searchable, editable, and works offline.

projects.title: Deep Calls
projects.summary: Long-form Christian apologetics essays for people who ask hard questions, built from Markdown by a custom Python static-site generator.

projects.title: Family Roots
projects.summary: A private family tree with a story for each person, a timeline, search, and invite links that give relatives an editor or viewer role. Prints as an outline and backs up to a file.

projects.title: KBIS Records
projects.summary: Staff-only student records and fee accounts for KBIS Schools: student search, itemised fee accounts per term, fee structures and stock. Works offline and installs to the home screen.

projects.title: Educator AI Toolkit
projects.summary: Guide for Nigerian teachers to set up one Claude Project that writes weekly lesson notes and exams with marking guides, plus 117 Scheme of Work files for JSS1 to SS3.

projects.title: Akinyele Spelling Challenge
projects.summary: Official site for the 2026 Akinyele Spelling Challenge in Ibadan: results, format, a large word bank, a practice trainer with a Spelling Bee game, and an event gallery.

projects.title: Timekeeper
projects.summary: Clock, countdown, stopwatch, focus timer and alarms in one quiet interface. Runs in the browser, stores nothing on a server, and works offline once installed.

projects.title: Personal AI Career Engine
projects.summary: Free four-phase guide to building a personal AI career engine with NotebookLM and a Claude Project, then generating CVs, cover letters and bios from your real history.

projects.title: AI Studio to Android Guide
projects.summary: Multi-page guide from Google AI Studio to GitHub to Vercel to an installable Android app, with troubleshooting, a glossary and a free-tier reference table.

projects.title: Knowledge Base International Schools
projects.summary: Public website of Knowledge Base International Schools, Moniya, Ibadan: admissions, academics, facilities, ICT, alumni and news.

projects.title: Personal Projects
projects.summary: A build log of small web and Python projects, with a searchable front page that links to each one.

projects.title: QuizMaster (David's copy)
projects.summary: Three-screen starter quiz (home, question, result) from a Techbase class session.

projects.title: QuizMaster (Ire's copy)
projects.summary: Three-screen starter quiz (home, question, result) from a Techbase class session.
